verdict.rationale: Cal.com's API v2 covers most UI capabilities (bookings, event types, schedules, webhooks, routing, conferencing apps, managed users) and docs explicitly frame the API as AI-agent-ready, plus an MCP server exposes these operations to AI clients. However, evidence doesn't confirm full UI parity (e.g., no mention of API access to billing/compliance settings, app marketplace management, or admin/org settings via API), and an official OpenAPI spec could not be found (404s), making completeness hard to verify. missing for 10: confirmed full parity for admin/org-level settings and marketplace app configuration via API, a published OpenAPI schema, independent hands-on confirmation that all UI actions are API-reachable.
